## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Táng Cí'ēn-school sub-commentary by [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8) **Zhìzhōu** (668–723), the third patriarch of the Cí'ēn-school, on Kuījī's [KR6n0124](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0124) *Dàshèng fǎyuàn yìlín zhāng* 大乘法苑義林章. Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X55n0883. The function-marker *juézé jì* 決擇記 ("decisional notes") indicates a commentary that resolves disputed readings and clarifies obscure passages of the parent text — a sub-commentary in the question-and-answer (*wèndá* 問答) format characteristic of the Cí'ēn-school's *juézé* genre.

**Abstract**

The *Juézé jì* is one of the three principal Cí'ēn-school sub-commentaries on Kuījī's *Yìlín zhāng* (alongside [慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC)'s [KR6n0125](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0125) *Bǔquè* and parallel Japanese Hossō works in T71). [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8) Zhìzhōu (668–723), Huìzhǎo's disciple and the third patriarch of the Cí'ēn-school, completed the structural consolidation of the Yìlínzhāng tradition by providing the working analytical backbone in *juézé* (decisional question-and-answer) form. The text is therefore both a continuation of the *Yìlín zhāng* itself (clarifying its difficult passages) and a key vehicle for the Cí'ēn-school's settled exegetical positions in the third generation after Xuánzàng.

The dating window 700–733 brackets Zhìzhōu's productive period, with a slight extension on the late side because the catalog meta records "唐" but the work continued to be edited after his death. The Manji recension is the late-imperial Luòyáng manuscript discovery noted in the preface; the original Táng text is otherwise lost.
